new_jobs.title: Partner 16, Data Engineer - Global Partnerships
new_jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We've established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it's like to be in the founder's shoes. We've invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



The Global Partnerships team is dedicated to crafting an outstanding client experience for our trusted Limited Partners ("LPs"). The Global Partnerships Data Engineer owns and advances critical data infrastructure, systems, and automation that support the global partnerships activities of Andreessen Horowitz. This role operates with significant independence, leads complex cross\-functional initiatives, and serves as a technical and strategic thought partner across Global Partnerships and adjacent teams. We're looking for a data leader who can translate ambiguous business needs into scalable systems, reliable pipelines, and practical insights.



We are open to candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area.


**To join our team, you should be excited to:**
-----------------------------------------------


**Own and advance the Global Partnerships data ecosystem**


* Lead ownership of critical systems, including the Global Partnerships core datasets and data pipelines. Serve as a technical and strategic thought partner to Global Partnerships and adjacent teams on data practices, automation, and scalable process design
* Design and maintain scalable data infrastructure and reliable pipelines that connect Global Partnerships systems and reduce manual work and error rates
* Uphold the highest standards of data precision and monitor and rectify discrepancies across different platforms
* Evaluate and implement tools and integrations to improve visibility, connectivity, and decision\-making


**Champion AI adoption across Global Partnerships**


* Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools and agentic workflows that remove manual work and give the team leverage, then drive team\-wide adoption through training, documentation, and change management
* Lead automation, process development, and operational scale. Enhance processes through automation to achieve data accuracy, reliability, and speed
* Act as the team's AI thought partner, staying current on emerging tools and translating them into concrete, high\-leverage improvements to LP\-facing and internal processes


**Leverage data to enable practical insights on our portfolio and the industry**


* Build visualizations and quantitative analyses that provide key insights on fund and investment performance including projected exit scenarios, liquidity and follow\-on decisions
* Develop strong fluency with the firm's portfolio company information database and be able to manipulate and analyze data from the system to draw insights
* Refine and calibrate portfolio performance analyses to stay current and relevant

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* Minimum of 5 years of experience. Preferable past experience includes but is not limited to, data analytics or data engineering
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a technical field preferred but not required
* Demonstrate a critical eye and keen attention to detail for written prose and charts, tables and spreadsheets and the ability to stay on top of changing data/facts across multiple documents with ease
* Strong writing skills: The ability to communicate effectively through the written word is a critical skill
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining data workflows, automations, or integrations using tools such as Python, Javascript, or a comparable programming language
* Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross\-functional projects with substantial autonomy and influence stakeholders across technical and business teams
* Experience owning or administering complex data pipelines or another critical business system, with a focus on data completeness, governance, and integration
* Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


* You have a sense of urgency and value the courtesy of professional responsiveness (this is super important as speed is a form of client service)
* You are able to adapt on the fly and handle unforeseen developments with ease. You are also able to do this without compromising attention to detail and quality
* You are a "measure twice, cut once" type of person – you are comfortable and have a preference for asking more questions upfront to avoid an oversight down the road
* You strive to be an enabler who gives the team maximum leverage \- there is no job too big, no job too small
* You do what you say you are going to do, when you say you are going to do it
* You continually search for new ideas and means of improvement
* You are a dedicated team player that is willing to wear multiple hats
* Most importantly, you take your work seriously but not yourself too seriously
* You anticipate business needs, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and design solutions for scale
* You can break down complex processes, identify high\-leverage improvements, and guide teams through change
* You are a trusted partner and emerging leader whom peers consult on data practices, systems, and efficiency

**Reports to:** Lead Platform Engineer

**About ReflexAI**
------------------


At ReflexAI, we are building the operating system for conversation performance. We believe that people will always be at the center of high\-stakes conversations, and our mission is to ensure they enter those conversations with confidence and deliver an exceptional experience every time. Our platform combines hyper\-realistic AI\-powered training simulations with intelligent QA to support frontline teams in mission\-critical conversations. Our tools work in 25 languages, are endlessly customizable to meet each business’s unique needs, and are used by customers ranging from crisis support call centers to healthcare organizations to customer service teams to sales teams negotiating big deals — any organization where empathy, quality, and excellence matter in every interaction.


**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Senior Platform Engineer** to establish and grow ReflexAI’s Platform Engineering function. This is a high\-impact, multidisciplinary role for someone who thrives in growing startups, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and is excited about working cross\-team in a mission\-driven organization .


You will improve and maintain our multi\-cloud infrastructure (GCP \+ AWS), expand our golden paths and guardrails, refine our observability and monitoring, and elevate our security and compliance posture with every commit. As the second member of a new team, your input to our technical vision, partnerships with other teams and engineers, and expertise and ability to deliver high quality software and systems will make you successful.


This is a rare opportunity to join a fast\-scaling AI company that believes in the value of platform engineering, getting your hands dirty building tools, infrastructure, and processes used daily by every engineer.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Build and Refine Core Infrastructure**

* Design, automate, and reduce the toil associated with maintaining ReflexAI’s multi\-cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS.
* Work with Terraform and Terragrunt, Github, Kubernetes, associated tooling, and the new generation of AI\-driven development tools
* Create safe, reliable, scalable, speedy, and secure paths for software and systems to reach production.

### **Build a High\-Quality Developer Experience**

* Own the tooling that engineers use to build, test, and deploy code.
* Standardize pipelines, templates, guard rails, and golden paths to accelerate developer velocity.
* Introduce and improve internal tooling that reduces operational overhead.

### **Streamline Observability, Monitoring, and Operations**

* Improve on\-call ergonomics and reduce MTTR through better instrumentation.
* Drive observability, reliability, security and cost efficiency with Datadog

### **Strengthen Infrastructure Security**

* Implement best practices for secrets management, IAM, network security, vulnerability scanning, and container security.
* Build automated checks and secure\-by\-default workflows into CI/CD and cloud environments.
* Help establish the compliance and security practices that ensure ReflexAI meets industry and customer expectations.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5–7\+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, and platform engineering roles.
* Deep hands\-on expertise with cloud platforms (GCP and AWS) as well as Terraform and Terragrunt, CloudRun, Fargate, and managed Kubernetes.
* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, guard rails, and golden paths for modern application stacks.
* Proficiency in modern observability ecosystems (Datadog experience is a major plus).
* Solid understanding of cloud security, IAM, container security, and network architecture.
* Experience with and excitement about AI\-driven development.
* U.S. citizenship is required. This role supports ReflexAI's U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs contract and requires access to systems for which citizenship is a condition of access.

### **Nice to haves**

* Experience working in a fast\-growing startup environment.
* Backend\-related coding experience, primarily with Typescript
* Background supporting machine learning, LLM serving, or data\-intensive workloads.
* Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, HITRUST) and knowledge of how this impacts infrastructure, reliability, and platform work.
* Prior experience building internal developer platforms or paved\-path tooling.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You thrive in environments where the best idea wins.
* You enjoy building tools and systems that increase the productivity of every engineer.
* You seek ownership and autonomy, but also value strong cross\-team collaboration.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Some of the most rewarding work you will ever do, solving real problems and helping people be the best versions of themselves. We work with organizations around the world to empower their people to optimize every conversation and perform their best when it matters most \- healthcare, veteran support, crisis management, emergency dispatch, and mental health.
* Work alongside a team that is exceptionally smart and ambitious, but also humble and kind
* Flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in the United States
* Generous retirement, equity, healthcare, and PTO policies

 *ReflexAI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race/ethnicity, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, military status, neurodiversity, or any other federal, state or local protected class in the United States.*


Compensation Range: $190K \- $210K

**Join Tech @ Ro to build the future of healthcare, from the ground up!**



At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest\-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.



We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.


**At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's** ***core to how we deliver care*****.** We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end\-to\-end experience for millions of patients.



…and we’re just getting started.



As part of Tech @ Ro, you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:


* Solve complex, high\-concurrency problems across a full\-stack platform
* Build and ship quickly with tight feedback loops and real\-world impact
* Own systems end\-to\-end, from architecture to production performance
* Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
* Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered


We’re a performance\-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.



If you’re motivated by impact, scale, and the chance to help lead the patient revolution, come build with us.

### **The Role**


We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who will supercharge the organization by more fully unlocking Conversational Analytics. You thrive in a startup setting, where every day is different and the problems that you’re tackling don’t have established solutions.

The role will have two primary focuses:
1\) building data models/semantic models, documentation, context, and evaluations to strengthen our LLMs’ ability to consistently achieve the correct answers, and  

2\) training non\-data stakeholders to more efficiently and effectively interact with our data stack.

You will start your time by diving deep into day\-to\-day analyst work and as you build a strong understanding for how data is used by end stakeholders and build business context. You’ll then transition to building out tooling that allows stakeholders to self\-service via Conversational Analytics. You take pride in developing tools, processes, and working frameworks and teaching your colleagues how to use them to better leverage data to generate insights and operationalize data. You have a bias for action, strong communication skills and a continual learning mindset.
### **What You'll Do**

* For the first 2\-3 months, embed with a stakeholder team to dive into day\-to\-day analyst work, build stakeholder relationships, and develop business fluence
* Build foundational data models, semantic models, documentation, and context that power conversational analytics across a variety of data domains (growth, product, business metrics, operations etc.)
* Approach opaque, unstructured problems by developing core analytic frameworks and standardized semantic models that shape the way the company thinks about our business
* Communicate and collaborate with different stakeholders to identify opportunities and build solutions that standardize our data approach to common problems across the company
* Teach and guide stakeholders on best practices for using LLMs for their own data needs, and distill what works into reusable training materials
* Develop and maintain AI evaluations for conversational analytics, tracking accuracy programmatically and building stakeholder feedback loops

### **What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* 4\+ years of full\-time working experience in quantitative analysis roles, with a portion of that time focused on data modeling in DBT
* Hands\-on experience using LLMs for coding and analytics, going beyond asking simple questions and building data products through LLM workflows
* Expert\-level SQL skills
* Experience using BI tools (ours are Hex and Looker) to effectively convey information
* Strong communication and teaching skills
* Strong problem solving skills, analytical aptitude, and numerical dexterity
* Demonstrated track record of project ownership

### **Nice\-to\-haves**

* Experience with AI evaluation of LLM tools
* Experience developing data pipelines and processes
* We are open to data analysts with demonstrable interest and project experience who are looking to make the transition to analytics engineer

When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including location, job\-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

  

Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021\. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

new_jobs.description:
**About Wonder**


Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.


Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot.


Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Team**


Developer Experience \& AI Velocity is a new team chartered to own developer experience for Wonder Engineering — 400\+ engineers across multiple converging organizations — with AI as the primary lever. We build the tools, integrations, and practices that let engineers ship faster, with less overhead and controlled costs.


AI coding tools are now a primary interface for writing, reviewing, testing, and debugging software at Wonder, but adoption so far has been left to individual engineers with no team officially owning the space. We're changing that: standing up the toolchains, workflows, and golden paths that a combined engineering org will run on, starting with code review at scale, context infrastructure for AI agents, and AI\-assisted paths for well\-understood engineering work.

**About The Opportunity**


We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help stand up this team from its earliest days and bring AI\-enabled development practices to Wonder Engineering. You'll design and build solutions to solve context fragmentation, MCPs/CLIs, skills, sub\-agents, and integrations that connect AI tooling to Wonder's codebases and systems, and the AI\-assisted workflows — code generation, review, testing, documentation, refactoring, on\-call/incident management — that engineers use every day.


This person brings proven AI\-tooling developer patterns and practices from outside Wonder that we haven't yet discovered internally. You'll partner closely with the team's other engineers across the company, each of whom owns a distinct part of the developer\-experience surface area, and with the platform, infrastructure, and application teams whose workflows you're improving.

**The Impact You Will Make**

* **Build AI\-Native Developer Tooling:**Design and ship Context aggregation solutions, MCPs/CLIs, skills, and sub\-agents that give AI coding tools sanctioned, reliable access to Wonder's codebases, services, and systems. Help define and stand up Wonder's autonomous development agents and cloud agent solutions.
* **Bring Outside Patterns In:**Bring a sharp point of view on where AI\-assisted development actually creates leverage across review, testing, code generation, and documentation, and translate the best emerging practices into standards that fit Wonder's stack, scale, and constraints.
* **Raise the Ceiling on Review:**Contribute to pre\-review and triage tooling that clears and automates mechanical and policy issues before a human looks, and help define standards for reviewing AI\-generated code.
* **Instrument for Efficiency, Not Just Adoption:**Design and implement the systems that optimize AI costs across the org and abstract model selection away from engineers' day to day, so the platform routes each task to the right model at the right cost without every engineer having to reason about it. Help define and measure Developer velocity.
* **Guide Technical Outcomes:**Scope, design, and ship developer tooling with minimal oversight, weighing tradeoffs and partnering with platform, infrastructure, and application teams to land it in production.
* **Communicate Effectively:**Write clear specs and documentation, and provide, seek, and incorporate feedback from a team and organization still defining its own practices.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including recent, hands\-on work building with or on top of LLM\-based tooling (agents, MCP servers, coding assistants, or similar).
* Direct experience integrating AI tools into real development workflows — code review, testing, code generation, or documentation — beyond individual use as an end user.
* Strong system design skills and a track record of owning tools or platforms end\-to\-end, from design through adoption.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity: this is a new team without established playbooks, and you'll be shaping them.

Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As a Software Engineer II on the Eater Real Time Pricing team, you will build the surge pricing algorithms that keep Uber's delivery marketplace healthy. Our systems produce real\-time decision signals that other critical systems \- matching, courier pricing, promotions \- depend on every second. The team sits at the intersection of the supply and demand sides of the business: when our pricing is right, the marketplace balances; when it is off, consumers and couriers feel it within minutes.
  

  

The problems here are complex and the stakes are immediate. Demand spikes with weather, holidays, and events; supply shifts city by city; and our algorithms must respond in real time with imperfect information. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, care about correctness under load, and want a short line from their code to visible marketplace outcomes. If you are energized by problems where algorithms meet the physical world \- this is where you'll grow.

* Build and scale real\-time pricing and forecasting systems that serve decision signals to matching, courier pricing, and other downstream consumers at high throughput and low latency.
* Own the software lifecycle end\-to\-end: from design docs through production rollout, debugging live issues, and managing incidents in a system where minutes matter.
* Collaborate across disciplines \- Product, Applied Science, and Ops \- to translate ambiguous marketplace problems into simple, robust system designs.
* Champion engineering best practices through quality code reviews, comprehensive tests, and strong monitoring of systems that must degrade gracefully under extreme demand.
* Navigate cross\-team dependencies and stakeholder inquiries to keep pricing signals reliable across every city we serve.

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

------------------


The Security Engineering team at Decagon protects the platform that powers the most advanced conversational AI agents for enterprise customers across voice, chat, email, and SMS. We build the security foundations that enable Decagon's AI agents to handle sensitive customer data with complete trust while defending against sophisticated, AI\-enabled threats at massive scale.


This role sits at the intersection of Security and Infrastructure. Like the rest of our Infrastructure org, we believe the best security comes from paved paths, strong SLAs, and high\-quality systems that other engineers can rely on by default. Our mission is to secure magical support experiences, ensuring that AI agents and human agents can collaborate safely to help users resolve their issues while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy.

As the first dedicated engineer at this intersection, you'll have outsized impact on how security infrastructure is built here, and you'll shape the technical direction of the infrastructure security program. You'll also help us invest in automation, observability, and self\-service so the team operates with confidence.
